airhockey.name: Freeze
airhockey.desc: Freeze the other paddle for a moment.

airhockey.name: Giant Paddle
airhockey.desc: Your paddle grows huge for 5 seconds.

airhockey.name: Split Puck
airhockey.desc: The puck splits in two. Either one can score.

pingpong.name: Smash
pingpong.desc: Your next return flies super fast.

pingpong.name: Slow-mo Return
pingpong.desc: The ball slows right down as it comes to you, for 3 seconds.

pingpong.name: Curve Ball
pingpong.desc: Your next return bends away from the other paddle.

penalty.name: Curve Shot
penalty.desc: Your next shot swings out wide, then bends back on target.

penalty.name: Wide Keeper
penalty.desc: Your keeper is extra wide for your next save.

penalty.name: Decoy Ball
penalty.desc: Your next shot sends a fake ball too. The keeper has to pick one.
